create_onestop_english_dataset: create a OneStopEnglish classification dataset instance with elementary, intermediate, and advance labels
run_k_shot_data_generation: run k-shot data generation for the OneStopEnglish dataset with multiple random seeds
load_onestop_english_hf_dataset: load the onestop_english HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method
split_train_test_lines: split the OneStopEnglish training data into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
